notes: To install: Open Download Page downloads the update in your browser. Open the downloaded file, drag Production Runner onto Applications and choose Replace. Your productions are kept.

What's New in 0.1.1: Production Runner 0.1.1 updates the public beta: Home, Script (Write and Breakdown, with Cast ID and Reports), Shots, the Scheduler, Contacts, Locations and Tasks, all working on your own computer. Make the Sample Production again to see it all.
Script: Writing and tagging your script now happen in one module, Script: write or import in Write, then tag cast, props and other elements in Breakdown.
The Scheduler: Plan your shoot: drag scenes onto shooting days on the Board, see which days each actor works in Cast Days, make call sheets and write Daily Reports.
Printing on the Mac: File > Print now opens the print dialog on a Mac. In 0.1.0 it could not print.
